claim: Positive port-specific rescaling of one shared bilateral transcript-tree cost preserves a rectangular ASMP-4 region with rescaled thresholds. Genuinely different cost orderings need not: over all finite binary prefix-free codebooks in an exact four-plan synchronous no-side-channel game, expected read length and worst-case write length have only the Pareto minima (7/4,3) and (2,2); public repeated blocks have frontier upward-closure conv{(7/12,1),(2/3,2/3)} and exclude the coordinatewise lower corner.

heterogeneous_fixture.codebook_class: all finite binary prefix-free read/write codebooks
